notes: WhaleChat 3.53.0 - market tick ring-buffer persisted to Postgres (whalechat_market_ticks) so /api/market/history and the candle chart open with full history after every redeploy; Twelve Data added as a third live price source alongside Finnhub and Binance, with the Alpaca panel removed and replaced by a Twelve Data API key card in Admin > Markets; WhaleChat (WC) company stock is now a continuously counting live symbol and drives the WC-Investing daily return; B2B-Investing gains a holdings-performance chart (black live price, green user sell target, red admin buy price) and the TradingView symbol-overview widget on the marketplace, asset and trade views; trade chart defaults resized for desktop and mobile.
